movers.text: QB Carson Beck (back) is ruled out at Kansas City; Josh Johnson starts, with Joey Aguilar as backup. Gardner Minshew is on IR after UCL surgery.
QB Baker Mayfield (foot/right thumb) is listed questionable but slated to play at Detroit, per NFL Network's Ian Rapoport. Jalon Daniels is the backup.
QB Kyler Murray (hamstring) is ruled out; Kirk Cousins starts against San Francisco in Mexico City.
OL: OT Taliese Fuaga (knee), C Erik McCoy (biceps) and OT Asim Richards (knee) are all ruled out at Chicago. Three line starters missing.
CB DaRon Bland (ankle) went on IR Saturday, S Jalen Thompson (hamstring) was downgraded to out, and G Tyler Booker (high-ankle sprain) is out vs. Tennessee.

ARI.text: QB Carson Beck (back) is ruled out at Kansas City; Josh Johnson starts, with Joey Aguilar as backup. Gardner Minshew is on IR after UCL surgery.
G Jon Gaines II (ankle) is out a fourth straight game; C Hjalte Froholdt is cleared from concussion protocol and starts.

TB.text: QB Baker Mayfield (foot/right thumb) is listed questionable but slated to play at Detroit, per NFL Network's Ian Rapoport. Jalon Daniels is the backup.
S Antoine Winfield Jr. (ankle) is out for Sunday at Detroit.

MIN.text: QB Kyler Murray (hamstring) is ruled out; Kirk Cousins starts against San Francisco in Mexico City.
WR Jordan Addison had thumb surgery and is out; the Vikings will not place him on IR, per Kevin O'Connell.
TE T.J. Hockenson (wrist) has no injury designation and LB Blake Cashman (concussion) is cleared; both are back vs. San Francisco.

NO.text: OL: OT Taliese Fuaga (knee), C Erik McCoy (biceps) and OT Asim Richards (knee) are all ruled out at Chicago. Three line starters missing.

KC.text: OL: G Trey Smith (concussion) and OT Jaylon Moore (ankle) are out vs. Arizona. RB Kenneth Walker III (groin) is also out.

NYJ.text: QB Geno Smith (ankle) has no injury designation and starts at the Chargers. WR Omar Cooper (ankle) is out; G Dylan Parham (knee) is questionable.

BAL.text: QB Lamar Jackson (thumb surgery, IR) could return Week 16, per ESPN's Dan Graziano. Jacoby Brissett starts at Carolina.
CB Marlon Humphrey won't play at Carolina (team decision); S Jaylinn Hawkins (knee) and DT Nnamdi Madubuike (hamstring) are ruled out.

DET.text: DE Aidan Hutchinson (torn ACL) is out for the season; C Cade Mays (ankle) was placed on IR Saturday. CB D.J. Reed (hip), out two games, is questionable.

DAL.text: CB DaRon Bland (ankle) went on IR Saturday, S Jalen Thompson (hamstring) was downgraded to out, and G Tyler Booker (high-ankle sprain) is out vs. Tennessee.

BUF.text: CB Christian Benford (groin) and LB Dorian Williams (calf) are out vs. Miami; TE Dalton Kincaid (thumb/ankle) is doubtful.

CHI.text: CB Kyler Gordon (shoulder) is out vs. New Orleans, per the Bears' final injury report.

SF.text: WR Mike Evans (Achilles tendinitis), who has missed three games, is questionable vs. Minnesota in Mexico City; LB Dre Greenlaw (neck) is also questionable.

MIA.text: QB Malik Willis (groin/core) is on IR; Kyle McCord remains the starter at Buffalo.
S Dante Trader Jr. (shoulder/groin) is doubtful at Buffalo; C Aaron Brewer (concussion) is questionable.

PHI.text: Joe Milton starts vs. the Steelers for a second straight game; Tanner McKee is the backup. Jalen Hurts is on IR.
LB Zack Baun (back) and WR Dontayvion Wicks (ankle/foot) were placed on IR Saturday.
WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring), out five of six games, practiced fully and will play vs. the Steelers.

CIN.text: G Dalton Risner (knees) is ruled out for Monday at Washington; G Dylan Fairchild (oblique) is questionable. QB Joe Burrow (illness) has no designation.
S Kyle Dugger (quadriceps), out six games, is questionable for Monday at Washington.

WAS.text: CB Amik Robertson (ankle) and G Lucas Patrick (concussion) are questionable for Monday vs. Cincinnati.

JAX.text: C Robert Hainsey (knee) is out for Sunday at the Giants, per Liam Coen.

LV.text: TE Brock Bowers (ankle) is questionable at Denver; he said Friday his availability is still up in the air.

PIT.text: G Mason McCormick (dislocated ankle) is on IR; LB Patrick Queen (hand) is questionable at Philadelphia. WR Michael Pittman Jr. is not expected to be activated.

TEN.text: WR Carnell Tate (shoulder), out two games, is expected to play at Dallas, per NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.
WR Wan'Dale Robinson (ankle) is on IR and out for the season, per Robert Saleh.

DEN.text: S Talanoa Hufanga (ankle), out four games, has no designation vs. Las Vegas; CB Kris Abrams-Draine is back. S Brandon Jones (hamstring) is questionable.

LAC.text: LB Daiyan Henley (knee) is ruled out vs. the Jets; CB Tarheeb Still (ankle) is questionable.

IND.text: The Colts released QB Daniel Jones; Shane Steichen named Anthony Richardson the starter going forward, with Riley Leonard as backup.
